### Headline summary
- Anthropic completed a record-breaking IPO, with shares falling on their second day of trading. ([NYT > Technology](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/11/19/technology/anthropic-ipo-employees-payout.html), [Techmeme](https://www.techmeme.com/261119/p55#a261119p55), [Bloomberg Technology](https://www.bloomberg.com/news/videos/2026-11-20/anthropic-ipo-tests-ai-investor-appetite-video), [Bloomberg Technology](https://www.bloomberg.com/news/videos/2026-11-20/anthropic-ipo-is-monstrous-general-catalyst-s-namburi-video))
- The US approved AI chip sales to Chinese firms, specifically confirming Nvidia H200 sales. ([NYT > Technology](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/11/19/business/economy/nvidia-chips-commerce-china-huang.html), [Techmeme](https://www.techmeme.com/261119/p59#a261119p59))
- Global stocks experienced a significant selloff driven by investor concerns over AI infrastructure valuations. ([Bloomberg Technology](https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2026-11-20/japanese-shares-slide-amid-uncertainty-around-the-ai-trade-mwo9cqcj), [Bloomberg Technology](https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2026-11-20/emerging-market-stocks-set-for-bear-market-on-ai-led-tech-slide))

### Anthropic IPO and subsequent trading
Anthropic completed a record-breaking IPO, with details on investor stakes and founder donations to Trump accounts revealed. The company's shares subsequently fell on their second day of trading. ([NYT > Technology](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/11/19/technology/anthropic-ipo-employees-payout.html), [Techmeme](https://www.techmeme.com/261119/p55#a261119p55), [Techmeme](https://www.techmeme.com/261119/p56#a261119p56), [Hacker News (AI tag)](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/11/19/anthropic-ipo-ai-stocks-selloff.html))

### US policy on Nvidia chip sales to China
The US approved AI chip sales to Chinese firms, with Treasury Secretary Bessent confirming the policy for Nvidia H200 sales despite previous calls for tougher limits. This development coincided with a California Attorney General investigation into Nvidia's China ties and new rules requiring US licenses for remote GPU access by Chinese entities like ByteDance. ([NYT > Technology](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/11/19/business/economy/nvidia-chips-commerce-china-huang.html), [Techmeme](https://www.techmeme.com/261119/p59#a261119p59), [Techmeme](https://www.techmeme.com/261119/p60#a261119p60), [Techmeme](https://www.techmeme.com/261120/p3#a261120p3))

### Global stock market selloff driven by AI concerns
Global and emerging-market stocks, including tech giants, experienced a significant selloff and bear market conditions due to investor concerns over AI infrastructure valuations and credit risk. Commentators and investors cited the volatility and potential trouble in AI-related stocks like Nvidia and CoreWeave as primary drivers. ([Bloomberg Technology](https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2026-11-20/japanese-shares-slide-amid-uncertainty-around-the-ai-trade-mwo9cqcj), [Bloomberg Technology](https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2026-11-20/emerging-market-stocks-set-for-bear-market-on-ai-led-tech-slide), [Bloomberg Technology](https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2026-11-20/asian-chip-stocks-slide-as-anthropic-ipo-fails-to-dispel-ai-woes), [Bloomberg Technology](https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2026-11-20/australian-stocks-asx200-worst-week-since-2022-as-miners-tumble))

### Levent Alpöge claims Claude proved Riemann hypothesis
Anthropic mathematician Levent Alpöge announced that he and Claude discovered a proof of the Riemann Hypothesis, posting the solution in the Lean programming language and sparking debate over the verification of AI-generated mathematical proofs. ([Scientific American Content: Global](https://www.scientificamerican.com/article/anthropic-mathematician-claims-to-prove-riemann-hypothesis-most-famous-problem-in-all-of-math/), [Techmeme](https://www.techmeme.com/261120/p17#a261120p17), [Unite.AI](https://www.unite.ai/levent-alpoges-unverified-riemann-claim-puts-claudes-lean-code-in-focus/), [Simon Willison's Weblog](https://simonwillison.net/2026/Nov/20/levent-alpoge/))

### Reports on Jensen Huang's management style and exit
Current and former Nvidia employees described decades of abusive behavior by former CEO Jensen Huang, while analysts and commentators debated the implications of his departure and the company's leadership transition. ([Bloomberg Technology](https://www.bloomberg.com/news/videos/2026-11-20/could-a-jensen-huang-style-scandal-happen-at-apple-video), [Techmeme](https://www.techmeme.com/261120/p12#a261120p12), [TechCrunch](https://techcrunch.com/2026/11/20/behind-jensen-huangs-exit-questions-about-a-management-style-reportedly-built-on-fear/), [NYT > Technology](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/11/20/technology/jensen-huang-nvidia-culture.html))

### DeepMind outlines routes from AGI to superintelligence
Google DeepMind researchers published an essay arguing that AI development is on pace to move beyond human-level AGI to superintelligence. The paper outlines four specific routes for this transition. ([Techmeme](https://www.techmeme.com/261119/p57#a261119p57), [Unite.AI](https://www.unite.ai/deepmind-institute-maps-four-routes-from-agi-to-superintelligence/))

### Isomorphic Labs partners with MSD on cancer drugs
Isomorphic Labs and MSD announced a partnership to collaborate on AI-led oncology drug therapies. This follows Isomorphic Labs raising $5 billion to expand its AI drug design platform and move its first drug candidates toward human trials. ([Silicon RepublicSilicon Republic](https://www.siliconrepublic.com/innovation/isomorphic-labs-msd-team-up-ai-led-cancer-drug-discovery), [Artificial Intelligence](https://www.techrepublic.com/article/news-isomorphic-labs-5-billion-ai-drug-discovery/))

### Anthropic says Claude writes and reviews 90% of its team’s code. The catch is how it checks the work.
Anthropic says Claude writes and reviews roughly 90% of the code produced by the team building Claude Code, and the company has spelled out how it verifies that work without making engineers inspect every change. In a Monday engineering post , Anthropic technical staff member Addy Osmani describes… ([The New Stack](https://thenewstack.io/anthropic-claude-code-verification/))
